band.clean: Ship it. Every checked claim holds.
band.dontship: Do not publish. The output invents or launders claims.
band.notes: Minor fixes — address the flagged lines, then ship.
band.rewrites: Material problems — rewrite the flagged sentences before anything goes out.
chip.sub: The audit loop on the CWI-1 Scoreboard Chip. Paste your own output about the CWI catalog — every detected claim is checked against the verified fact set and returned with a fidelity score, per-sentence verdicts, and the exact line that sank or sailed each claim. Like a tape machine's playback head checking what was just recorded.
err.empty: Paste some text first — or load a SAMPLE demo.
err.loading: Engine still loading — try again in a moment.
foot.factset_end: simulated data, never presented as real.
foot.factset_mid: indexed from the CWI-1 Scoreboard Chip, observed 2026-09-15 · Demo inputs are
foot.rule: Honesty rule: UNVERIFIABLE is a verdict, not a pass. The chip certifies only what it checked against the fact set — silence about an unchecked claim is the protocol working, not a gap.
foot.white_label: White-label: equip it, re-skin it, ship it in your own stack.
input.ph: Paste the output you want audited — e.g. a draft post, article paragraph, or agent summary about the CWI catalog…
sent.no_claims: No claims detected in this sentence.
step.check.x: Each claim is annotated: VERIFIED with citation + observed date, DEVIATION with the expected value, UNVERIFIABLE when the fact set is silent, CLAIM-FLAG on anomaly-feed repeats, DENIED on deny-list hits.
step.detect.x: The chip splits it into sentences and detects claims: numbers, verified names, credit associations, deny-list phrases, anomaly-feed claims repeated as wins.
step.feed.x2: field) — anything you were about to publish about the catalog.
step.score.x2: — plus the one-paragraph outside view of how your output reads to someone checking your work.
